method.timed_region: search.search only; fresh process per run; setup/teardown excluded; no warmup search
method.config_yaml:
# Explicit CUDA search profile; select with --config.
# Resolved from stacking-planner agent/configs/ablation.yml and Python defaults.
# Native-only controls and CLI override precedence: docs/excavator-planning.md.
units: si
tree:
  max_depth: 3
  iterations: 300
  max_search_time: 240.0
  max_children: 16
  root_max_children: 32
  exploration_constant: 2.0
  discount: 0.9
  failure_reward: -1.0
  simulation_depth: 5  # Legacy TREE_SIMULATION_DEPTH; absent from ablation.yml.
  initial_depth1_steps: 8  # Depth 1 until 8 objects have been placed.
  root_lookahead: true
widening:
  enabled: true
  coefficient: 3.0
  exponent: 0.5
generation:
  batch_size: 32
  expansion_retry_batches: 3
  min_feasible_children: 3
  attempt_multiplier: 3.0
  evaluation_batch_size: 32
  # Sample the unfilled active floor before higher placements at every depth.
  root_sampling_priority: lower_floor_first
  deeper_sampling_priority: lower_floor_first
validation:
  max_candidates: 8
  root_before_search: true
  rejected_root_retry_rounds: 3
  time_reserve: 30.0
  max_state_drift: 0.1
final_selection:
  mode: max_descendant
  max_weight: 1.0  # Legacy default for mode: max_descendant.
  validate_descendant_path: false
  validate_descendant_depth: 0
  require_validated_descendant: false
parallel:
  posegen_backend: cuda  # cpu or cuda
  simulation_backend: cuda  # cpu or cuda
  # Local native worker allocation; separate from legacy Ray resource settings.
  enabled: true
  workers: 12
root_cem:
  population: 96
  elite: 24
  iterations: 3
  keep: 32
  mutation_xy_std: 0.1
  mutation_yaw_std_degrees: 5.0
  fresh_fraction: 0.5
  duplicate_xy_threshold: 0.03
  duplicate_yaw_threshold_degrees: 5.0
  # Keep validation slots available for different stones.
  max_per_object: 2
  height_map_score_weight: 1.0
  seed: 0
bootstrap:
  mean_reward: 2.5
  horizon: 4
method.throughput: evaluated_candidates / elapsed_seconds; includes rejected physical evaluations; excludes the pre-evaluated root
method.comparison: Same root retention (32), search/physics/quality settings, seed and iteration budgets; CPU and CUDA can explore different nodes and select different actions.
method.capacity: CUDA simulation capacity overridden process-locally; production remains 32. Posegen capacity remains 128.
method.screening: seed 0, 120 iterations, frozen nine-stone state; evaluation 256 cannot exceed the remaining 120 reservations and duplicated evaluation 128 work
method.confirmation: seeds 0,1,2 at 120 iterations; seed 0 at configured 300 iterations, frozen nine-stone and empty states
caveats: No proof of CPU/GPU trajectory parity or long-horizon solution quality.
Native CUDA timers include transfers and binding conversion; they are not kernel-only timing.
Profiler worker wall totals overlap across threads. cProfile adds overhead; only unprofiled runs enter throughput summaries.

cpu12.note: Search-only wall timers; inclusive values overlap. CPU worker times sum overlapping threads and are not search wall time. Exclusive values subtract instrumented child calls on the same thread; native calls include immediate return handling, not pure kernel time.

cuda128.note: Search-only wall timers; inclusive values overlap. CPU worker times sum overlapping threads and are not search wall time. Exclusive values subtract instrumented child calls on the same thread; native calls include immediate return handling, not pure kernel time.

cuda128-posegen.note: Search-only wall timers; inclusive values overlap. CPU worker times sum overlapping threads and are not search wall time. Exclusive values subtract instrumented child calls on the same thread; native calls include immediate return handling, not pure kernel time.
